note: Language-independent v3 vectors: invalid_structural is refused by raw schema; invalid_semantic passes raw schema but violates normative admission. Selection/follow/replay are context-dependent semantics. Combined vectors show stdout/stderr origin joined before capture carried as one channel, never relabelled or split. No runtime qualification.

selection.name: common v1 intersects channels and audiences and lowers the frame limit
unknown newer versions and other families are ignored
only a newer version is no common version
empty advertisement is no common version
malformed selected v1 entry is refused, not tolerated
v1 entry above the frame bound is refused
oversized unknown entry bounds the whole advertisement
combined is selected when both peers offer it
a peer that does not offer combined never selects it
combined only against separated only has no common channel
a peer advertising only v2 has no common version
an older entry beside the selected entry is ignored even when v3 would refuse its shape

follow.name: contiguous frames end in a durable reference
exact eviction gap then frames
hidden gap is refused
at-least-once redelivery is a duplicate
incarnation change without discontinuity is refused
restart reports the exact lost tail
restart with unknown lost extent then a gap
restart with nothing lost
discontinuity that does not answer the cursor is refused
old incarnation after a restart is refused
nothing follows finalization
ended without a durable reference
gap overlapping held frames is refused
gap already covered is a duplicate
data on an undeclared channel is refused
record for another stream is refused
data above the selected frame limit is refused
control fact without a control channel is refused
pty may be declared and carried without a control channel
combined output is carried as one channel, closed and ended
stdout data on a combined stream is refused
combined data on a separated stream is refused
closing a separated channel on a combined stream is refused

replay.name: retained cursor resumes without a gap
cursor just before retention resumes without a gap
cursor behind eviction gets an exact gap
previous incarnation gets an exact discontinuity then a gap
cursor ahead of its previous incarnation
unknown incarnation gets a discontinuity of unknown extent
finalized redirect: only the finalized frame is retained
finalized at final cursor with unknown terminal metadata
finalized at final cursor with known terminal metadata
finalized cannot be evicted as an ordinary empty window
ended at final cursor with unknown terminal metadata
ended at final cursor with known terminal metadata
ended cannot be evicted as an ordinary empty window
